scripts.text:
You have too many items to proceed with the quest.
Please lighten your load and try again.
scripts.translation:
您携带的物品过多，无法继续任务。
请减轻负重后再试一次。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Ah... you...
based on TE rules, I won't be ordering you or asking you favors unfortunately.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
啊……你……
根据TE的规则，很遗憾，我不能向你下达命令，也不能请你帮忙。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There are missions you can complete in TE region.
Let's see, what do you want?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在TE区域有一些可以完成的任务。
让我看看，你想要什么？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hey now, since this place is just for primary and secondary job classes as well as users without expanded levels, could you leave if you got nothing else to do here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
喂，这里只面向初级和转职职业，以及未扩展等级的玩家。
如果你没什么事，请离开这里好吗？

scripts.text: Accept/Conform Missions
scripts.translation: 接受/确认任务

scripts.text: What do you mean a mission?
scripts.translation: 任务是什么意思？

scripts.text: I don't have any.
scripts.translation: 我没有。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mm, I'm sorry but missions are for users with ^4d4dff70 level^000000 or higher.
Honestly, it's hard to complete a mission if your level is too low.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，很抱歉，任务需要^4d4dff70级^000000或以上的玩家才能接取。
说实话，等级太低的话，任务很难完成。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You already know that you have to accept a mission in a certain period of time, right?
Unfortunately, you can't accept missions right now.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道必须在一定时间内接取任务，对吧？
很遗憾，你现在无法接取任务。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You already know that you have to accept a mission in a certain period of time, right?
Moreover, you have to keep in mind that you can't accept both high-level and low-level missions simultaneously if they are of the same content.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你知道必须在一定时间内接取任务，对吧？
另外，请注意，如果任务内容相同，你不能同时接取高级和低级任务。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Mm, you were taking a break?
Well, it doesn't matter anymore.
You can only check the results of the missions you've already accepted.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，你是在休息吗？
算了，这不重要。
你只能查看已接取任务的结果。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You can only check the results of the missions you've already accepted.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你只能查看已接取任务的结果。

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[{0}]
See you later then.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那再见了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You did it in time.
I don't understand why {1} appear at that time of the day.
Anyway, good job.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你在规定时间内完成了。
我不明白为什么{1}会在那个时间出现。
总之，干得好。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Time's up.
Unfortunately, mission failed!
Maybe next time!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
时间到了。
很遗憾，任务失败！
下次再试吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You're not on this mission currently.
Could you check again?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你目前不在该任务中。
请再确认一下。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You are already on a high-level mission!
You cannot accept a low-level mission if you're already on a high-level mission of the same content!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你已经在进行高级任务了！
如果任务内容相同，你不能在高级任务期间接取低级任务！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You're already on a elimination mission!
I would like you to take care of what you already have unless you want to cancel it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你已经在进行歼灭任务了！
除非你想取消，否则请先完成手头的工作。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I've been told that {1} appear during the busy siege hours at the fortress in {2}.
I would like you to ^4d4dffeliminate {3} or more of {4}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我听说{1}会在{2}要塞的繁忙攻城时段出现。
我希望你^4d4dff歼灭{3}只或以上的{4}^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Incredible!
Breaking Emperiums is definitely not an easy job.
You must be contributing a lot to your guild. Good job!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不可思议！
破坏华丽金属绝对不是一件容易的事。
你一定为公会做出了很大的贡献。干得好！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You're already on a mission of the same content,
the level is different though
I would like you to take care of what you already have unless you want to cancel it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你已经在进行相同内容的任务了，
只是等级不同。
除非你想取消，否则请先完成手头的工作。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There is something called 'commercial development level' in each fortress.
It increases as much as each guild invests.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
每个要塞都有一个叫“商业发展等级”的东西。
它会随着公会的投入而增加。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The break for commercial development of the fortress is over now.
Good. Think about what kind of missions you want and come back again.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
要塞的商业发展休息时间结束了。
很好，想想你想要什么样的任务，然后再回来吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What is the most important thing in siege battles?
It's destroying Emperiums! Let me give you that exact mission of destroying Emperiums!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
攻城战中最重要的是什么？
当然是破坏华丽金属！让我给你布置一个破坏华丽金属的任务吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
{1} or more of {2} let's see you've done it right.
{3}
Anyway, good job.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
{2}中的{1}个以上，让我看看你是否做对了。
{3}
总之，干得好。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Hmm you wouldn't believe it, but this mission is related to a theft.
They told me a bunch of {1} is missing from the fortress in {2}.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯，你肯定不敢相信，但这个任务与一起盗窃案有关。
他们告诉我，{2}要塞里丢失了一批{1}。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
[{1}]
Since TE Region has more of a casual atmosphere,
it's not fun doing just siege battles, right?
So, I brought ^4d4dffsome works you can do during the siege hours^000000~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
[{1}]
既然TE区域的气氛比较轻松，
光是打攻城战未免太无趣了，对吧？
所以，我准备了一些^4d4dff你可以在攻城期间完成的工作^000000~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Since you've done a good job, I'll let you open my tool box {1} times.
Although you won't find anything mostly...
It's a bonus, so don't complaint even if you don't find anything.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然你表现不错，我就让你打开我的工具箱{1}次。
虽然里面大多没什么东西...
这是额外奖励，就算没找到什么也别抱怨哦。

scripts.text: Just like {0} said, you went through the box in front, and...
scripts.translation: 就像{0}说的，你翻遍了前面的箱子，然后...

scripts.text:
Time's up.
Unfortunately, mission failed!
Maybe next time!
scripts.translation:
时间到了。
很遗憾，任务失败！
下次再试试吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It only makes sense that way, doesn't it?
Don't you think so?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这样才说得通，不是吗？
你不觉得吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Since you've done a good job, I'll let you open my tool box {1} times.
Although you won't find anything mostly...
It's a bonus, so don't complaint even if you don't find anything.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然你表现不错，我就让你打开我的工具箱{1}次。
虽然里面大多没什么东西...
这是额外奖励，就算没找到什么也别抱怨哦。

scripts.text: Just like {0} said, you went through the box in front, and...
scripts.translation: 就像{0}说的，你翻遍了前面的箱子，然后...

scripts.text:
Time's up.
Unfortunately, mission failed!
Maybe next time!
scripts.translation:
时间到了。
很遗憾，任务失败！
下次再试试吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It only makes sense that way, doesn't it?
Don't you think so?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这样才说得通，不是吗？
你不觉得吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
However, this is closely related to Emperiums.
Destroying Emperiums repeatedly staggers commercial development level.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不过，这与华丽金属密切相关。
反复破坏华丽金属会动摇商业发展等级。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
So, now we take a break in order to prevent an excessive decrease in commercial development level.
See you in a bit.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
所以，现在我们要休息一下，以防止商业发展等级过度下降。
稍后见。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Gloria or Kafragarten, wherever it is! Right now, at this very hour, ^4d4dffdestroy Emperiums!^000000
^4d4dffTarget number is {1} or more!^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
无论是格洛丽亚还是卡普拉贾登，不管在哪里！就在此刻，^4d4dff破坏华丽金属！^000000
^4d4dff目标数量是{1}个以上！^000000

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Let me take the rest of the {1}.
I'll return it to its original owner.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
剩下的{1}就交给我吧。
我会把它归还给原主。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Since you've done a good job, I'll let you open my tool box {1} times.
Although you won't find anything mostly...
It's a bonus, so don't complaint even if you don't find anything.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然你表现不错，我就让你打开我的工具箱{1}次。
虽然里面大多没什么东西...
这是额外奖励，就算没找到什么也别抱怨哦。

scripts.text: Just like {0} said, you went through the box in front, and...
scripts.translation: 就像{0}说的，你翻遍了前面的箱子，然后...

scripts.text:
Time's up.
Unfortunately, mission failed!
Maybe next time!
scripts.translation:
时间到了。
很遗憾，任务失败！
下次再试试吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It only makes sense that way, doesn't it?
Don't you think so?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这样才说得通，不是吗？
你不觉得吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
The thief probably took advantage of the siege hours.
It's a request to find ^4d4dff{1} or more of {2}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
小偷很可能利用了攻城时间。
这是一个寻找^4d4dff{2}中{1}个以上^000000的请求。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Since TE Region has more of a casual atmosphere,
it's not fun doing just siege battles, right?
So, I brought ^4d4dffsome works you can do during the siege hours^000000~
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
既然TE区域的气氛比较轻松，
光是打攻城战未免太无趣了，对吧？
所以，我准备了一些^4d4dff你可以在攻城期间完成的工作^000000~

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You can accept missions ^4d4dffstarting from 1 hour before the beginning of the siege and until the end of the siege battle TE^000000,
and every mission has ^4d4dffa 4-hour time limit^000000 for completion.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你可以在^4d4dff攻城开始前1小时至TE攻城战结束期间^000000接受任务，
且每个任务都有^4d4dff4小时的完成时限^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Simply put, you accept a mission from me during the siege hours and
^4d4dffcome back to give me a report within the time limit^000000.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
简单来说，你在攻城期间从我这里接受任务，
然后^4d4dff在时限内回来向我汇报^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Try it for fun.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
就当是玩玩看吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I see.
Come back anytime if you change your mind.
I might not be available, though. Hehehe.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
明白了。
如果你改变主意，随时可以回来。
不过我可能不在哦。呵呵呵。

scripts.text:
It seems like you haven't accomplished the mission yet?
{0}
scripts.translation:
看起来你还没有完成任务？
{0}

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Do you want to cancel by any chance?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你是想取消任务吗？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Good luck!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
As you wanted, this mission is canceled.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如你所愿，该任务已取消。

scripts.text:
Hmm you still have some time left, but it's not the siege hour yet
I don't think you should go on.
You should cancel this mission. I would say it's failed.
scripts.translation:
虽然你还有剩余时间，但现在还没到攻城时段。
我觉得你不该继续了。
你应该取消这个任务。我会判定它失败。

scripts.text: I would like to go on.
scripts.translation: 我想继续。

scripts.text: Yes, I'll cancel it.
scripts.translation: 是的，我要取消。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I don't think it's worth it. Well, good luck!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我觉得不值得。好吧，祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
As you wanted, this mission is canceled.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
如你所愿，该任务已取消。

scripts.text: Accept it.
scripts.translation: 接受

scripts.text: Do not accept it.
scripts.translation: 不接受。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^4d4dffThe time limit is 4 hours.^000000
Accomplish the mission with in that time and report to me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^4d4dff时限为4小时。^000000
请在规定时间内完成任务并向我汇报。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Try another mission then.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那就试试别的任务吧。

scripts.text: You didn't find anything.
scripts.translation: 你什么也没找到。

scripts.text: You found '{0} !'
scripts.translation: 你找到了'{0}'！
